title: Implement eight-child identity transfers and centre-query codes
body:
This construction changes the historical complex supplier's local target operation from `X-JY` to the exact subtraction **`X-Y`**, while an invertible source code stores the full eight-coordinate centre query in eight existing fields. A forward companion performs `(G^-1X,Y+G^-1X)`. Each complete word restores all 480 arbitrary helpers and adds **eight rank-one native children and no array field**.

**The complete kappa bound is unchanged.** This is a local construction and an enabling theorem. It resolves the identity-target and full-query encoding requirements at the actual native cuts. A complete supplier must still close the changing-chart controller, remove the source code, and pay all address, precision, storage, hosting, and recursive costs.

Evidence: [ordered proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/UNIT-TRANSFER-PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/unit-transfer-certificate.json), [cold replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/evidence/UNIT-TRANSFER-REPLAY.json), and [independent package review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/UNIT-TRANSFER-REVIEW.md).

For `J=I-KR`, the theorem assumes `RP=LK=I` and `LP=0` over a unital coefficient ring. With ordered products,

```text
Z=K-P(RK-I), Q=R-L,
G=(I-PL)(I+ZQ), G^-1=I+PL-ZR,
LG=R, RG=Q, JG-I=-P[R+(RK-I)Q], G^6=I.
```

The target correction is supported on P. The source code fixes a 96-dimensional complement and rotates two eight-dimensional sections with matrix `[[0,-I],[I,I]]`. No inverse of 13, scalar Gram assumption, or commutation assumption is used. Order six applies to a fixed chart; products of changing charts need not have order six.

For the actual dyadic supplier, a modulo-13 rank argument proves that every identity-target preparation needs at least eight target repair rows. The construction attains eight. This optimum covers the stated source-preparation/target-row interface, not arbitrary native circuits. The proof also gives a conditional full-query transport law between compatible selected-coordinate routes, without inverting the cross-chart query matrix. Full source restoration does not follow from that law.

| Complete word | Data map | Scalar allowance |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Backward | `(X-Y,GY)` | 217898 |
| Forward | `(G^-1X,Y+G^-1X)` | 217898 |

Both words have complete original-rank profile `{1:2420,2:418,3:432,4:142,5:82}`, of mass 5530 versus retained mass 5522. Each uses 16 explicit address maps for its eight new children. The scalar total is `202138+9056+6704`; it counts real primitives per array coordinate and is not a full recursive or precision bill. All eight owned private outputs are zero. The new work uses only existing C0. These words are companions, not inverse calls.

The [four original source-group examples](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/PROOF.md) remain byte-exact and are replayed in the same command. Their complete scalar allowances remain 218794, 218794, 222846, and 225794. They preserve the clean-J target while changing the source.

The exact base is [`bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f). Inputs come from the frozen [PR #1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) [source archive](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/community-frontier1042-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz), also used by the historical [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) assembly. All consumed source and credit objects remain in [SOURCES.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/SOURCES.json). This PR does not require an unmerged PR implementation.

With Python 3.10 or later, Git, and that base object in the local database, run from the repository root with a new output directory:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/native-source-codes/replay_unit_transfers.py \
  --repo . --out /tmp/native-unit-transfer-review
```

Expected output:

```text
PASS_UNIT_TRANSFER_EXTENSION
Four published examples and both unit transfers passed all 712 formal input columns.
The eight positive and eight inverse native recipes passed all 8192 Gaussian columns.
The complete supplier and kappa calculation are unchanged.
```

Root and isolated independent cold replays passed and produced byte-identical receipts. A separate reviewer reconstructed both new words directly from the pinned source archive without importing the producer, verifier, or campaign modules. All six complete words pass 712 input columns, arbitrary helper restoration, and private-output checks. The added positive and inverse recipes pass 8192 exact Gaussian columns, including scalar phases. Checks cover both source inverse orders, serial query reads, order six, noncentral coefficient examples, native cuts, scalar costs, and formal prefix bounds. Negative controls reject early source/target updates, wrong factor order, missing compensation, positive lines at inverse exits, wrong phases, and missing private clears. Global routing/decoding, complete supplier pricing, and a new kappa calculation were not established. No complete supplier or repository-wide suite was run for this local addition.

Related corroboration is Chafik Boukhalfa's (@chafreaky) [PR #1877](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1877). Its [pinned proof](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4d9fa6016682c910be06e55b1c974d53052aee76/research/sourcecode-commutant/PROOF.md) proves an endpoint-support tradeoff and an unchanged-frame obstruction for the original clean-J-preserving logger. It leaves changed codes and paid or later native transitions open. This package consumes none of that code or certificate.

The retained [gauge notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/NOTICE.md) credits @icekylinx. The [t16 notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/t16/NOTICE.md) credits Hao Yan (@FanPUYen) for integration, Jeremy Kothe (@jeremykothe2) for the [PR #799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/799) local supplier, and Chafik Boukhalfa (@chafreaky) for the [PR #741](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/741) frame work. The [slot-word source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots/README.md) credits @rohanarun for [PR #987](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/987) and NewBArch for [PR #869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/869); no account is inferred for NewBArch. Exact notices and further lineage remain in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/NOTICE.md). The loader and replay tools share the campaign's source work with [PR #1719](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1719), without requiring that PR to merge.

Related mutable-source work is Hanson Sun’s (@bbMisk) [PR #1522](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1522). Its [pinned proof and scope](https://github.com/bbMisk/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04379bb9bf8d394891df9b48edbfa79882aedae2/research/shared-dyadic-source/README.md) share a restored source-query tour across distinct BIT outputs under an exclusive mutable-source contract. This package uses the complex input interface, fixed-support source codes, and identity-target transfers. It consumes none of that package’s code or certificate.

New research, implementation, and independent agent review used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance under the user's direction. No independent human review is claimed. New material uses Apache-2.0. The [open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bb29ea73ad9be9a0c3d53cdcb1d22b2ee9ffe42f/research/native-source-codes/README.md) specify the remaining restoration and chart-transition constructions.
